prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the mold from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: mobile robot platform
What the inspection checks: Check whether a mold is on mobile robot platform.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Overhead view of a white plastic baseplate resting on a white foam sheet, with a dark grey tiled floor visible at the right edge.

Mounted on the plate: two square white blocks at left (upper and lower), each with a raised circular disc on top and four screws at the corners, both closed. At upper right, a similar square block with an open circular through-hole showing a recessed bore, secured by corner screws.

Centrally, an elongated white rectangular module lies lengthwise, its top face bearing two columns of six square copper-coloured pads (twelve total), with small screws at its four corners.

The plate has several empty holes and inset fasteners. A small metal fitting protrudes at the bottom edge. No liquids visible.
observations: The photo shows a white baseplate on foam with several square blocks (some closed, one with an open bore) and an elongated module with copper pads, but the description does not identify the platform as the mobile robot platform nor clearly identify any of these items as the mold, so presence of a mold cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
